verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's docs explicitly cover multi-agent applications including agent delegation (one agent delegates to another and takes back control), programmatic agent hand-off patterns, and durable execution across such workflows, with typed dependencies/outputs enabling composition. missing for 10: no dedicated 'crew'-style orchestration primitive (e.g., built-in graph/crew abstraction beyond delegation) and no independent hands-on report specifically validating multi-agent handoff reliability in production.
